name: Uren-Vetluga Gas Pipeline (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)
researcher_notes: NEW ROW (proposed): ~78 km high-pressure inter-settlement gas pipeline from Uren to Vetluga, northern Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, part of the Gazprom-region gasification programme (2021 Nikitin-Miller programme; 2026-2030 programme 'in signing' Jan 2026). No roster match: no Vetluga/Uren-town endpoint in the GGIT roster or gas snapshot (Obkhod-Shakhunya/Tonkino/Tonshaevo are separate lines from GRS Obkhod, Urensky District; this line starts at Uren town and runs to Vetluga; Vetluzhsky-Varnavino is a different line). ADD-THRESHOLD: (a) sponsor = Gazprom group in Nizhny Novgorod (regional gas distribution company Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod, general director Morozov quoted on the programme; Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Nizhny Novgorod statement below); (b) endpoints Uren-Vetluga, Nizhny Novgorod Oblast; (c) concrete step = JUDGEMENT CALL: gipernn 2026-01-22 quotes Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Nizhny Novgorod that 'a contract has been concluded for the 75 km pipeline to Vetluga' with construction timing to follow once the programme is approved (counterparty and contract type, design vs construction, not stated); design had been scheduled 2025-26 (gipernn Dec 2024). If the reviewer reads an unspecified contract as insufficient, downgrade to monitor (sibling vetluzhsky-varnavino was monitored for lack of any such step); (d) length 78 km sourced twice (regional energy minister, Dec 2023 gipernn; Jan 2026 committee hearing via vz-nn.ru, minister Kurenkov), so >=25 km. LENGTH CAVEAT: the Mezhregiongaz company statement says 75 km; the Dec 2024 gipernn piece (sroki-...) says the line will be '75 km longer than originally planned', which conflicts with 78 km and may be a garbled reading of the 78 km total; 78 km kept as the figure from two ministerial statements, 75 km noted. Timing: construction 2027, commissioning 2027-28 (vz-nn: 2027-2028; gipernn 2026-01: build 2027, launch 2028; Governor Nikitin Sept 2026: 'next stage includes Vetluga and Varnavino', pravda-nn). Candidate evidence nn.mk.ru 2026-01 does not mention Uren-Vetluga (url_verifier FAIL on 'Ветлуг') so not cited; newsroom24/1prime/rnews not cited (cover Shakhunya line only). Owner entity: entity_lookup finds no close match for the Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Nizhny Novgorod subsidiary (new entity to create; Parent Gazprom PJSC exists); Owner is the programme's builder/operator by inference, not stated for this line alone. Tier medium (two ministerial statements on length are one lineage; status = programme plan only). Route: no route found, none staged (RouteType/RouteAccuracy left for routes leg; line is a straight corridor Uren-Vetluga ~ on the Uren-Vetluga road, no GIS source found). Diameter, capacity, cost, FID not stated.
